functions.name: mlk_poly_add
functions.role: In-place polynomial coefficient-wise addition helper for `mlk_poly`; adds `b` into accumulator `r` across all `MLKEM_N` coefficients.
outputs: No return value; mutates `r->coeffs[i]` in place
modified_memory: Does not write `b` according to the loop body and read-only parameter qualification
preconditions_or_contracts: `r` and `b` are both required to be non-aliased fresh objects of size `sizeof(mlk_poly)` by the header contract.
For every coefficient index `k0`, `r->coeffs[k0] + b->coeffs[k0] <= INT16_MAX`.
For every coefficient index `k1`, `r->coeffs[k1] + b->coeffs[k1] >= INT16_MIN`.
postconditions_or_contracts: Loop invariant states already-processed coefficients satisfy `r->coeffs[k1] == loop_entry(*r).coeffs[k1] + b->coeffs[k1]` for processed indices.
Loop invariant states not-yet-processed coefficients remain equal to their entry-state values.
Header contract states `r->coeffs[k] == old(*r).coeffs[k] + b->coeffs[k]` for all `k`.
Body comment says the preconditions imply the addition stays within `int16_t`.
The function does not perform modular reduction; output is the raw signed sum cast to `int16_t`.

evidence_references.excerpt: for (i = 0; i < MLKEM_N; i++) ... invariant(forall(k0, i, MLKEM_N, r->coeffs[k0] == loop_entry(*r).coeffs[k0])) ... invariant(forall(k1, 0, i, r->coeffs[k1] == loop_entry(*r).coeffs[k1] + b->coeffs[k1])) ... r->coeffs[i] = (int16_t)(r->coeffs[i] + b->coeffs[i]);
evidence_references.supports_claim: In-place coefficient-wise addition, loop shape, and in-loop old-state/new-state relationship.

evidence_references.excerpt: void mlk_poly_add(mlk_poly *r, const mlk_poly *b) ... requires(memory_no_alias(r, sizeof(mlk_poly))) requires(memory_no_alias(b, sizeof(mlk_poly))) requires(forall(... r->coeffs[k0] + b->coeffs[k0] <= INT16_MAX)) requires(forall(... r->coeffs[k1] + b->coeffs[k1] >= INT16_MIN)) ensures(forall(k, 0, MLKEM_N, r->coeffs[k] == old(*r).coeffs[k] + b->coeffs[k])) assigns(memory_slice(r, sizeof(mlk_poly)))
evidence_references.supports_claim: Signature, no-alias preconditions, overflow preconditions, old-state postcondition, and write footprint.

evidence_references.excerpt: Add two polynomials in place. The coefficients of r and b must be such that the addition does not overflow. Otherwise, the behaviour of this function is undefined.
evidence_references.supports_claim: Function intent and overflow-safety expectation.

functions.uncertainty: The header contract expresses addition in raw `int16_t` terms and does not assert any modulo-q normalization for the output; whether later callers reduce the result is outside this function.
limitations: The implementation source was available, but there is no formal proof artifact attached to this stage.
The function is specialized to a destructive accumulator form; the reference implementation comment notes this differs from the reference implementation's 3-argument form.

functions.name: mlk_poly_sub
functions.role: In-place polynomial coefficient-wise subtraction helper for `mlk_poly`; subtracts `b` from accumulator `r` across all `MLKEM_N` coefficients.
outputs: No return value; mutates `r->coeffs[i]` in place
preconditions_or_contracts: `r` and `b` are required to be non-aliased fresh objects of size `sizeof(mlk_poly)`.
For every coefficient index `k0`, `r->coeffs[k0] - b->coeffs[k0] <= INT16_MAX`.
For every coefficient index `k1`, `r->coeffs[k1] - b->coeffs[k1] >= INT16_MIN`.
postconditions_or_contracts: Header contract states `r->coeffs[k] == old(*r).coeffs[k] - b->coeffs[k]` for all `k`.
The body comment says the preconditions imply the subtraction stays within `int16_t`.

evidence_references.excerpt: for (i = 0; i < MLKEM_N; i++) ... invariant(forall(k0, i, MLKEM_N, r->coeffs[k0] == loop_entry(*r).coeffs[k0])) ... invariant(forall(k1, 0, i, r->coeffs[k1] == loop_entry(*r).coeffs[k1] - b->coeffs[k1])) ... r->coeffs[i] = (int16_t)(r->coeffs[i] - b->coeffs[i]);
evidence_references.supports_claim: In-place coefficient-wise subtraction and loop invariants.

evidence_references.excerpt: void mlk_poly_sub(mlk_poly *r, const mlk_poly *b) ... requires(memory_no_alias(r, sizeof(mlk_poly))) requires(memory_no_alias(b, sizeof(mlk_poly))) requires(forall(... r->coeffs[k0] - b->coeffs[k0] <= INT16_MAX)) requires(forall(... r->coeffs[k1] - b->coeffs[k1] >= INT16_MIN)) ensures(forall(k, 0, MLKEM_N, r->coeffs[k] == old(*r).coeffs[k] - b->coeffs[k])) assigns(memory_slice(r, sizeof(mlk_poly)))
evidence_references.supports_claim: Signature, no-alias preconditions, overflow preconditions, old-state postcondition, and write footprint.

functions.name: mlk_poly_reduce
functions.role: Normalize each coefficient of a polynomial to unsigned canonical representatives in `[0, MLKEM_Q-1]`.
outputs: No return value; mutates `r->coeffs` in place
preconditions_or_contracts: `r` must be a non-aliased fresh object of size `sizeof(mlk_poly)`.
postconditions_or_contracts: Header contract requires `array_bound(r->coeffs, 0, MLKEM_N, 0, MLKEM_Q)` after execution.
Implementation uses Barrett reduction followed by conditional addition of `MLKEM_Q` to move signed canonical representatives into `[0, MLKEM_Q)`.
